swap_rules: Default is to stay. Same-role swaps after a death win about 2.5 points fewer of the next fights than staying (score held equal); only 3.1% of swap matchups beat staying.

Swap when the swap answers the hero that is killing you: tank to Winston after a Widowmaker kill costs only -1.8 points vs -3.9 for an unrelated tank swap; DPS to Soldier: 76 after a Pharah kill costs -0.5 vs -3.9.
Comfort beats paper counters: swapping to a hero with under 30 min played in 90 days costs -5.1 points, 5+ hours costs -1.8. Only suggest heroes in the player's pool.
A real counter edge is 52-53% (prefer it if equally comfortable), 53-55% is worth swapping even if less practised, above 55% is a rare hard counter. Counters are modest; do not overstate them.
Lock counters only after the enemy comp is visible; an early counter gives the enemy a free re-pick.
Check what the team loses: a tank swap changes what supports can protect; a DPS swap changes ult economy. Only swap if the team can absorb it.
Counter-swapping matters most on tank (one tank per team in 5v5), so tank pools should be wider. Coaches converge on a primary plus a same-role secondary for counter-swaps and bans.
If the enemy comp holds two hard counters to your hero, switch to your backup; a hero under 50% at your rank is a reason to lean on the secondary.
Ult charge: a swap keeps at most 25% ultimate charge. Do not swap with ult nearly ready; spend it first.
Do not swap in a way that breaks the comp (no frontline, no healing), and do not swap mid-fight; swap while dead or in spawn.
Tanks who swap every death hurt their team more than any counter helps; one swap per clear, repeated problem.
Swap after the same threat stops your team two fights in a row (free sniper, unpressured Pharah, a flanker), not after one death.

Map and mode matter: an edge can vanish on another map or mode (Symmetra 49.2% on Push vs 59.4% on Flashpoint). Domina wants chokes and long halls (Havana, Junkertown) and struggles on high-ground maps (Gibraltar, Numbani).
Rank matters: below Diamond mechanics dominate and 1-2 heroes total is fine; matchups shift by rank, so weight counters less in low ranks.

swap_rule_sources.rule: Default is to stay. Same-role swaps after a death win about 2.5 points fewer of the next fights than staying (score held equal); only 3.1% of swap matchups beat staying.

Comfort beats paper counters: swapping to a hero with under 30 min played in 90 days costs -5.1 points, 5+ hours costs -1.8. Only suggest heroes in the player's pool.
A real counter edge is 52-53% (prefer it if equally comfortable), 53-55% is worth swapping even if less practised, above 55% is a rare hard counter. Counters are modest; do not overstate them.
Lock counters only after the enemy comp is visible; an early counter gives the enemy a free re-pick.
Check what the team loses: a tank swap changes what supports can protect; a DPS swap changes ult economy. Only swap if the team can absorb it.
